title: A Static for the Gravity
author: Paloma Vasquez
blurb: Coral Eriksen, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
